name: JV_TRANSACTIONS
description: This table will reference transactions that will be distributed among stakeholders of a joint venture.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the distributable transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture.

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.description: Header defining column for the transaction. This will hold either a je_header_id (for journal entry) or ae_header_id (for subledger accounting entry).

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Accounting line for the transaction. This will hold either a je_line_num (for journal entry) or ae_line_num (for subledger accounting entry).

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll. If this transaction is a journal entry a value of -99 will be populated.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the distributable transaction. It is based on ORA_JV_TRANSACTION_STATUS lookup codes such as ORA_JV_AVAILABLE_TO_PROCESS, ORA_JV_ERROR, or ORA_JV_ON_HOLD.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_PERCENT_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The ownership definition short name to be used when splitting the transaction amount for distribution to the stakeholders. This can be overridden from what was originally assigned.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_OWNERSHIP_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The original ownership definition short name to be used when splitting the transaction amount for distribution to the stakeholders. This is the value that was initially assigned when the transaction was created and can't be overridden.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder that is to be directly billed for the transaction. This can be overridden from what was originally assigned.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder that is to be directly billed for the transaction. This was originally assigned and cannot be overridden.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date used to identify when the transaction occurred. This may be different than the effective_date for the journal entry and the accounting_date for the subledger accounting transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: The accounting date on the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: The fiscal period assigned to the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account combination identifier for the account on the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: ENTERED_DEBIT
columns.description: The debit amount of the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CREDIT
columns.description: The credit amount of the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code entered on the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_DEBIT
columns.description: The debit amount of the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction in the accounted currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CREDIT
columns.description: The credit amount of the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction in the accounted currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description on the original source transaction used to create the joint venture transaction that is passed into the joint venture invoice.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the assignment rule used to assign the ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder to the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the carried interest agreement.

columns.name: CI_ORIGINAL_OWNERSHIP_NAME
columns.description: The original ownership definition short name that was used along with the carried interest agreement to generate the carried interest ownership definition. The carried interest ownership definition will be used to distribute the transaction to the stakeholders.

columns.name: ORIGINATED_FROM_JV_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source of the transaction is a joint venture invoice or journal originated by joint venture processing. The source of the transaction can also be payments or receipts against an invoice originated by joint venture processing.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of transaction to be processed, such as expense, revenue, asset, overhead, and so forth.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the project that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the project task that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_TASK_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the overriding task applied to joint venture distributions sent to Project Costing as cost adjustments.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the expenditure type that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the overriding expenditure type applied to joint venture distributions sent to Project Costing as cost adjustments.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the organization that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE
columns.description: Date when the expenditure associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction was incurred.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_BU_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the expenditure business unit that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the expenditure item that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the grouping of expenditure types that is associated with the subledger accounting entry for the transaction.

columns.name: OVERHEAD_AVAILABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the joint venture transaction is available to be used in overhead calculations.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the transaction will be used for distribution only and not invoiced.
